mapper.sql: SELECT o.or_no AS OR_NO, o.or_name AS OR_NAME, o.or_phone AS OR_PHONE, o.or_address AS OR_ADDRESS, o.or_addrdetail AS OR_ADDRDETAIL, o.or_memo AS OR_MEMO, o.or_yn AS OR_YN, o.or_qty AS OR_QTY, o.or_method AS OR_METHOD, o.or_status AS OR_STATUS, o.or_at AS OR_AT, o.or_up AS OR_UP, o.m_no AS M_NO, ('NR' || TO_CHAR(o.or_at,'YYMMDD') || LPAD(o.or_no,7,'0')) AS ORDER_NO_DISPLAY, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(od.od_amount),0) FROM dc_order_detail od WHERE od.or_no = o.or_no ) AS PRODUCT_AMOUNT, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(od2.od_quantity),0) FROM dc_order_detail od2 WHERE od2.or_no = o.or_no ) AS PRODUCT_QTY, NVL(pay.pay_fee,0) AS SHIPPING_FEE, NVL(pay.pay_dis,0) AS DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, NVL(pay.pay_real_amt,0) AS PAY_AMOUNT FROM dc_order o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.or_no, p.pay_fee, p.pay_dis, p.pay_real_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.or_no ORDER BY p.pay_req_at DESC, p.pay_no DESC ) AS rn FROM dc_payment p ) pay ON pay.or_no = o.or_no AND pay.rn = 1
mapper.insert: SELECT OR_NO FROM dc_order WHERE ROWID = ( SELECT MAX(ROWID) FROM dc_order ) INSERT INTO dc_order ( or_name, or_phone, or_address, or_addrdetail, or_memo, or_yn, or_qty, or_method, or_status, or_at, or_up, m_no ) VALUES ( #{orName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orPhone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orAddrdetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{orQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PAYMENT_PENDING', SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{mNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_order SET or_status = #{orStatus}, or_up = SYSDATE WHERE or_no = #{orNo}

UPDATE dc_order SET or_name = #{orName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, or_phone = #{orPhone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, or_address = #{orAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, or_addrdetail = #{orAddrdetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, or_memo = #{orMemo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, or_up = SYSDATE WHERE or_no = #{orNo}
mapper.select: WHERE o.m_no = #{mNo} ORDER BY o.or_at DESC
WHERE o.m_no = #{mNo} AND o.or_status = #{orStatus} ORDER BY o.or_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dc_order WHERE m_no = #{mNo}
